leads.name: Nossob Camel Thorn (reader's tip)
leads.location_hint: Along the Nossob riverbed road, between Twee Rivieren and Nossob Rest Camp
leads.reason: Reader: the park's most photographed tree, sociable weaver nests across its branches. Location is a stretch of road, not a spot: needs a coordinate. Needs two sources (or a register plus a life check) and a pin resolved from the reader's map link before it ships as a reader-found tree; nothing found against it.
